# Thrive Pain Clinic, Wellness & More (Hyderabad)

> Physician-led interventional pain management, regenerative spine care, and kinetic physical rehabilitation clinic in Raidurgam, Cyberabad, Hyderabad.

## Clinic Overview
- **Name**: Thrive Pain Clinic, Wellness & More

## Core Clinical Focus
- **Non-Surgical Interventional Spine Care**: Targeted, image-guided procedures (fluoroscopy and high-resolution ultrasound) for chronic lower back pain, sciatica, slip disc / herniated lumbar disc, cervical radiculopathy, and facet joint arthropathy.
- **Sciatica Interventions**: Transforaminal epidural steroid injections (TFESI), selective nerve root blocks (SNRB), radiofrequency ablation, and guided kinetic physiotherapy.
- **Regenerative Joint & Spine Medicine**: Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) therapy, Growth Factor Concentrate (GFC), and Prolotherapy for knee osteoarthritis, chronic tendon injuries, and spinal degenerative conditions.
- **Radiofrequency Ablation (RFA)**: Thermal and pulsed RFA targeting facet joint medial branch nerves and knee genicular nerves for long-lasting non-opioid pain relief.
- **Multidisciplinary Kinetic Rehabilitation**: In-house physiotherapy, biomechanical realignment, clinical nutrition, and pain psychology.

## Medical Leadership
- **Dr. S Dheeraj Kumar**: Interventional Pain Management Specialist & Founder. MD from Bangalore Medical College & Research Institute (BMCRI). Performed over 5,000 pain interventions. National Faculty at ISSPCON (Indian Society for Study of Pain) and ISACON. Recipient of Abdul Kalam Medical Excellence Award (2024) and ISTA Heal Excellency Award (2025).
- **Dr. Anahita Reddy**: MD (Anesthesiology), FIPM, FIRM. Pain, Regenerative & Palliative Medicine Specialist.
